# Agent Pi limits connector-change approval to the displayed revision


By OpenTools Team


October 30 notes distinguish revision‑specific consent from unanswered cards and routine tool updates.


##


Approve this revision


Agent Pi’s[version 2.5.102 notes](https://agentpi.app/changelog) say a suspicious connector‑tool change stops the connection and asks for approval. Accepting covers only the displayed revision; a newer change replaces that card. Consent therefore does not carry forward to later revisions.


##


An unanswered card


If a card ends unanswered through Stop, 24 hours or a restart, the next use asks again. Routine updates judged benign no longer interrupt chats. These are the publisher’s behavior descriptions, not independently verified security protections.


Original explanatory diagram: for a suspicious connector‑tool change, approval covers the shown revision; a newer change replaces the card. Not an interface.
